decisions.title: Film story anchors versus player exploration freedom
decisions.resolution: Major film chronology/outcomes remain fixed; exploration, side routes, optional conversations and living-world activity belong primarily between required story anchors.
decisions.rationale: Preserves the user's goal of living the film while allowing meaningful adventure and discovery.

decisions.title: Living-world richness versus target-laptop performance
decisions.resolution: Use rich near-player simulation and cheaper distance-adaptive/offscreen simulation; do not require always-on expensive AI for ambient life.
decisions.rationale: The world should feel alive without sacrificing the low-spec device target.

decisions.title: Source reorganization versus current functional validation gate
decisions.resolution: Define and guard the target Public/Private source architecture now, but perform the physical move as a dedicated maintenance pass after the current F9/F8/chapter/device functional gate is healthy.
decisions.rationale: Preserves organization without mixing a large path/include refactor into unresolved gameplay validation.
